hookups.source: https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-24 ('30/50 amp electric, water and sewer'), https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-27 (same), https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-18 ('30 amp electric and water'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Site pages are numbered 2-27. Electric-only sites ($35) fit RVs of 16-30 ft (sites 5 and 8: 16 and 20 ft; site 14 is tent-only); water/electric sites ($40) 27-30 ft, and site 22 is 'Not good for Class A or C motorhomes due to leveling issues'; the four full hook-up sites 24-27 ($49) take 35-40 ft and no tents.

sites.source: https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-26 and https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-27 ('Fits RV's up to 40''), https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-22, https://www.engediresort.com/campsite-5, read 2026-10-22. The stored 50 ft and ~30-site count came from note prose; the operator's longest site is 40 ft and it numbers its sites 2-27.

values.note: 'Open Memorial Day Weekend Through Labor Day Weekend'.

booking.source: https://www.engediresort.com/camping ('Book Now!'; 'Cancellations 8+ days before a reservation will receive a full refund minus one night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Electric RV/tent sites $35, water + electric $40, full hook-up $45-49 (the per-site pages price sites 24-27 at $49). $5 extra for more than 2 vehicles.

fees.source: https://www.engediresort.com/camping ('Electric RV / Tent Sites $35 per night', 'Water / Electric RV / Tent Sites $40 per night', 'Full Hook-Up RV Sites $45-$49 per night'; page announces July 23-24, 2027), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground on the St. Joseph River near Leonidas with an on-site canoe/kayak livery, a River Trail to the fishing and swimming area, and rental cottages; a no-alcohol, no-marijuana Christian-oriented family resort. One RV or up to two tents per site; no sleeping in cars, vans or trucks. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm $35-49/night (electric $35, W/E $40, full hook-up $45-49), season Memorial Day-Labor Day weekends, online booking. Per-site pages: full hook-up 30/50 amp at sites 24-27; max rig corrected 50 -> 40 ft; most electric-only sites take 16-30 ft. Cleared the note-derived ~30 site count (sites are numbered 2-27). Note cleaned of the wrong 'rest water/electric' and '50 ft' and of the season/site facts now in fields. A 23-ft Class C fits most sites; site 22 excludes Class A/C motorhomes.
